name: Mountain's Verdict

attributes.description:
A storm lies bound within its iron heart.

Stormcall: 12% chance on a successful normal weapon attack to discharge energy into your target for 30% physical attack damage, up to 18, and into one nearby enemy for 15%, up to 10. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
Legendary weapon cooldowns are shared by your character. Extra damage is based on the original attack before critical bonuses and mitigation; armor, resistance and player damage rules still apply.
